answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil swarms by demanding regional attestation spread: a newcomer earns standing only when its useful work is endorsed by strangers whose public endpoints sit in at least three different regions, each endorsement checked by an independent regional auditor. Identical voices from one ridge of servers echo the same origin and count once, so a farm cannot clone itself across the map. Honest agents naturally gather far-flung sponsors, while an island of fakes in a single datacenter stays stranded at the lowest standing, no matter how many names it mints.
